title: Modern tech and updated design
summary: Feedback centers on the G60 feeling modern or updated, with positive remarks on modern features and technology while many other mentions only describe the design or tech as modern without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's modern features, contemporary technology, and intuitive presentation.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the vehicle as modern, updated, sleek, or practical, but the brief wording does not make a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are very short and descriptive, so sentiment is often unclear.
The examples are narrowly focused on modernity, design, and technology, which limits detail about specific features.
This is a sentiment-stratified sample and not a representative estimate of all G60 feedback.
